text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After her debut, one of Mihono Bourbon's interviews is published as a magazine article.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, the article is highly critical and points out how a sprinter like her doesn't have the aptitude for the long-distance Triple Crown races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon is determined to place well at the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes in order to convince the public of her abilities.
